pr_title: Fix crash from the use of app.useTools after pasting (fix #2933)
pr_body: The document being "edited" is tested to see if it's writable, if it is not, its "status" is changed so it is writable. This PR fixes crashes in cases where an open document that has recently been pasted on puts the document in a read-only mode and thus cannot be drawn on.
pr_comments: Hi @iamOgunyinka, why this PR was closed? are you still working on #2933?

@dacap the PR addressed a part of the bug (the crash) and doesn't fix the bug in its entirety (the `useTool` didn't have any effect). It also messed around with the locks in the document, which @Gasparoken pointed out **may** not be the best way to go about it. So I've been tinkering around the editor and editor states to see if there is another way to solve it. 

And yes, I am currently working on this (although no viable solution in sight ATM as all `isMovingPixel` + `dropPixel` I've been trying keeps failing).

issue_context.title: Cannot use app.useTool() after app.Paste (and possible crash)
issue_context.body: With a script like this: ```lua app.command.Paste() app.useTool{ tool="pencil", points={1,1} } app.command.Cut() ``` 1. Create a sprite 2. Copy a selection to the clipboard 3. Run the script It will show: The `app.useTool()` should cancel the selection state of the editor. We should have also a chance to position the selection in some place with Paste command, etc. Reported: https://discord.com/channels/324979738533822464/527442731732041728/882960748572192839

review_comments: Do you know if it's necessary to deselect the mask? Or can we keep it selected?

I'll look into the `InlineCommandExecution`, see its usages and how I can make use of it.

Oh and when the mask is not deselected, the pencil tool (or any other drawing tool) does not work. Not just while scripting but even in the UI.
Do you know if the tool works inside the selection? (generally when the selection is active, the selection works like a clipping mask/filter where we can paint only inside the selected area)

I've just tested it. Without deselecting the mask, the pencil tool I switch to didn't work.

EDIT: By "did not work", I meant even in the selected mask.
